subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin emerged first from the tunnel, as he always leads from the front — it was as close to instinct as that dwarf ever got.
source_quote: Thorin first, which was correct — he always led from the front, always had, it was as close to instinct as that dwarf ever got.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum emerged second, blinking with something that looked less like discomfort and more like relief, experiencing a genuine spiritual moment with direct sunlight.
source_quote: Grygum next, blinking with something that looked less like discomfort and more like relief, the earnest half-orc having what appeared to be a genuine spiritual moment with direct sunlight.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz emerged last, as he always does, already observing before he was fully present, already composing the analysis before his feet had cleared the threshold.
source_quote: Daz came through last, the way Daz always came through last, already observing before he was fully present, already composing the analysis before his feet had cleared the threshold.

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth emerged with the rest of the surviving crew after Daz, part of the group who had survived this journey.
source_quote: The rest of our moltley crew followed, Eldeth, Spiderbait, and the rest of the folks who had survived this journey.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait emerged with the rest of the surviving crew after Daz, part of the group who had survived this journey.
source_quote: The rest of our moltley crew followed, Eldeth, Spiderbait, and the rest of the folks who had survived this journey.

subject: emergence into the Overbright
fact: The party emerged from the tunnel into the Overbright — a light that simply was, filling everything from every direction at once, causing the body to register a fundamental change, not as pain but as an existential shift.
source_quote: The light that came through the tunnel mouth was not like Dawnbringer's light, not like faerie fire or bioluminescence or any of the things we had been navigating by for however many months it had been — I genuinely cannot tell you how many months it had been. It was not a light that came from a source. It was a light that simply *was*, filling everything from every direction at once, and what I felt when it touched my face was a kind of violence, or close to it. Not pain. Just the body registering that something fundamental had changed, the same way a deep-water creature might register the pressure dropping.

subject: duration of tunnel journey
fact: The exact duration of the tunnel journey is unknown — the narrator has lost count and cannot tell how many months it had been.
source_quote: I genuinely cannot tell you how many months it had been.

subject: the Overbright
fact: The Overbright is a place of unnatural, self-sustaining light that fills everything from every direction, experienced as a profound and violent shift in perception, not a source-based illumination.
source_quote: The Overbright was a concept I had been carrying through Velkynvelve and Gracklstugh and the Darklake and Blingdenstone like a stone in a pocket, something I reached for when the tunnels pressed too close. I had stopped trusting it would be real. It was real. The light that came through the tunnel mouth was not like Dawnbringer's light... It was a light that simply *was*, filling everything from every direction at once...

subject: the tunnel mouth
fact: The tunnel mouth is the passage through which the party emerged into the Overbright, previously experienced as a long, disorienting climb where counting steps became superstition.
source_quote: The tunnel mouth opened like a held breath finally released. I had stopped counting the steps somewhere around the third hour of climbing — not because I lost track, but because counting had started to feel like superstition...
